title: DTI: ASEAN power grid may lower electricity rates, help PH in cases of shortage
summary: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Power Grid may lower the country’s electricity rates and will ease access to supply, Trade Secretary Cristina Roque said on Wednesday.
